Sardonic

sar-DON-ik · adjective

Hear It

What It Means

Sardonic is grimly mocking or cynical, especially in tone or facial expression.

He gave a sardonic smile when his boss praised the 'innovative' new policy that everyone knew was a disaster.

Worked Example

'Oh, wonderful, another mandatory meeting,' she said with a sardonic laugh, rolling her eyes as she grabbed her notebook.

Sardonic describes a mocking, scornfully amused tone -- often through a smile, laugh, or dry remark that says the opposite of what it seems to.

How Sardonic Sits Among Its Neighbors

Synonyms — open each to see how it differs

derisive

derisive: expressing contempt through mockery

scornful

scornful: showing open contempt

Antonyms

sincere

sincere: genuine, without pretense

earnest

earnest: serious and heartfelt

How Strong Is It? — wry → sardonic → contemptuous

wry vs. sardonic

wry vs. sardonic: Wry describes a dry, quietly amused tone, without necessarily being mocking or cynical the way sardonic is.

contemptuous vs. sardonic

contemptuous vs. sardonic: Contemptuous openly shows that someone or something deserves no respect at all -- harsher than sardonic's mocking edge.

Sort It Out

Now place each word on the right side of sardonic.

Build the Word

The pieces

root — sardon-

root — sardon-: of Sardinia (from Greek Sardonios, possibly linked to a legendary toxic plant said to twist the face into a deathly grin -- disputed origin)

suffix — -ic

suffix — -ic: characteristic of (Greek)

Put it together

Put it together: Sardonic is built from sardon- ('of Sardinia,' from Greek Sardonios -- though the origin is genuinely debated) + -ic ('characteristic of'). One old legend claims it comes from a poisonous Sardinian plant said to twist the face into a ghastly grin before death -- a 'sardonic grin.' Whatever the true source, the word has long meant a mocking, scornfully amused expression.

Use the root in a new word: Sardinia

Use the root in a new word: Sardinia: According to the old legend, the plant said to cause this deathly grin grew wild across the island of Sardinia.
